Name: Spirit Garden
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]The mod introduces seven new flowers, each with its own set of buffs. These flowers will bloom in 13 days, regardless of the season.

[/size][size=3]You can unlock the seeds by completing the community center. Visit Krobus’ shop to find them all.

It's my first time creating a crop mod, so please let me know if you come across any bugs. Don't hesitate to give me suggestions regarding the balance, names, colors, or anything else.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/puE8kJD.png[/img] Buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/dollymods]coffee[/url] if you want to help me make more mods [img]https://i.imgur.com/puE8kJD.png[/img][/size]
